Peanut Butter · Easy

Peanut Butter & Jam Squares

If your kids are bored of regular sandwiches, then here’s what you should do to give it a twist.

5 minPreparation
5 minCooking
2Servings

Ingredients

For 2 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Break egg in a bowl. Add castor sugar, cream, milk and whisk well.
  2. Spread peanut butter on one bread slice and jam on another bread slice. Put the jam bread on top of the peanut butter bread. Make remaining sandwiches similarly.
  3. Heat butter in a non-stick pan. Dip sandwiches in the egg mixture and place in the pan. Cook on both sides till golden.
  4. Cut into squares and dust icing sugar on top. Serve immediately.
